title: Diffploit: Facilitating Cross-Version Exploit Migration for Open Source Library Vulnerabilities
abstract: arXiv:2511.12950v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Exploits are commonly used to demonstrate the presence of library vulnerabilities and validate their impact across different versions. However, their direct application to alternative versions often fails due to breaking changes introduced during evolution. These failures stem from both changes in triggering conditions (e.g., API refactorings) and broken dynamic environments (e.g., build or runtime errors), which are challenging to interpret and adapt manually. Existing techniques primarily focus on code-level trace alignment through fuzzing, which is both time-consuming and insufficient for handling environment-level failures. Moreover, they often fall short when dealing with complicated triggering condition changes across versions. To overcome this, we propose Diffploit, an iterative, diff-driven exploit migration method structured around two key modules: the Context Module and the Migration Module. translated_title: Diffploit：促进开源库漏洞的跨版本利用迁移
translated_abstract: 利用通常用于证明库漏洞的存在，并验证其在不同版本中的影响。然而，由于软件演化过程中引入的破坏性变更，它们直接应用于其他版本时往往失败。这些失败源于触发条件的变化（例如，API重构）和动态环境的破坏（例如，构建或运行时错误），这些在手动解释和适应时具有挑战性。现有技术主要侧重于通过模糊测试进行代码级痕迹对齐，这既耗时又不足以处理环境级故障。此外，在处理跨版本的复杂触发条件变化时，它们往往力不从心。为克服这些限制，我们提出了Diffploit，一种迭代的、差异驱动的利用迁移方法，其结构围绕两个关键模块：上下文模块和迁移模块。上下文模块动态缓存...
tldr: Diffploit 提出了一种基于差异驱动的迭代利用迁移方法，通过上下文和迁移模块有效解决跨版本漏洞利用中的触发条件和环境故障问题。
en_tdlr: Diffploit proposes an iterative, diff-driven exploit migration method with context and migration modules to address triggering condition and environment failures in cross-version vulnerability exploitation.
